A '''meatalo''', as named by visitors to its [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], was a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]-shaped, meat, and [[Lard/Legends|lard]] dish from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]].<ref name="CCW" /> Created in Metellos' impoverished [[Moridebo district]], the confection could be prepared either by baking or roasting.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The meatalo was first mentioned in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[2003]] reference book, ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', which was published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CCW" />
